bagPolicy.summary: Bags, purses and backpacks up to 35 cm x 35 cm x 15 cm (14" x 14" x 6") are allowed.
allowed: Bags, purses and backpacks up to 35 x 35 x 15 cm (14" x 14" x 6")
Baby bags after a security check
prohibited: Bags larger than 35 x 35 x 15 cm
bagPolicy.note: Guests with oversized bags must return them to a vehicle or other secure place before entering. Event-specific rules can differ; Fan Services is at 604.899.7440.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at Rogers Arena can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: Guests with disabilities can use Gate 16 on Pat Quinn Way for pickup and drop-off. Curb ramps and elevators are available at this gate.

concessions.note: Food and beverage availability at Rogers Arena varies by event and operating setup. Review the linked official guest information before arrival.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: All entrances are accessible except Gates 3 and 7, and Gate 16 on Pat Quinn Way is the drop-off and pick-up zone for guests with disabilities. Buy accessible seating through Ticketmaster or call Fan Services at 604.899.7440. Assistive listening devices are available and service animals are welcome.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Rogers Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Tickets are mobile only. The Rogers Arena Ticket Centre is on the north side at Gate 10, open 9:00am to 5:00pm on weekdays and from 9:30am on event days until the headliner begins. Call 604-899-7676 for help.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Rogers Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
